description: This file defines SwiftUI and AppKit views for voice wake overlay text UI, including a transcript text view, vibrant label view, and custom NSTextView subclass handling keyboard events and editing callbacks.

classes.name: TranscriptTextView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view wrapping an AppKit NSTextView for displaying and editing transcript text, with callback handlers for editing and sending actions.

classes.name: VibrantLabelView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view displaying a clickable, attributed label with a vibrant appearance.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: An NSView subclass that detects mouse clicks to trigger a tap callback.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass that handles special key events like Enter, Shift+Enter, Escape, and Command+Enter, and manages editing state callbacks.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a coordinator object to manage NSTexView delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Constructs and configures the NSScrollView and NSTextView for the transcript display.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView with new attributed text when needed.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse click events in the ClickCatcher to trigger tap callbacks.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Handles focus acquisition, triggering onBeginEditing callback.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Handles focus loss, triggering onEndEditing callback.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Intercepts keyboard events to handle specific keys like Return and Escape for custom behaviors.
